title: One column set; unit shows number + year/make/model
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions. Raising a work order also needs create and edit work orders.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Your organization has two workplaces (locations), e.g. "Calgary South" and "Red Deer", and your user can open both; you switch between them with the location control in the header.
  4. Rows for an asset with a unit number (e.g. "402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia") and one without a unit number (e.g. a 2015 Kenworth T880 with the unit field empty).
  5. A second user who can open only "Red Deer" (Settings > Staff: one workplace only), with view customers.
  6. For step 4, a one-workplace organization if the environment has one; otherwise mark step 4 Blocked with that reason.
custom_steps:
1. Read the column headers; activate a tile and the Compliance inspection chip and read them again.
  2. Read the asset cell for the unit with a number and the one without.
  3. Sign in as the one-workplace user and open the tab; look for the Location column.
  4. In a one-workplace organization open the tab and look for the Location column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The same columns show whatever is active: asset, customer, (Location), service, due status, due (with confidence or rule beneath), work order (with its status), actions; cells adapt, columns do not change.
  • The unit reads "402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia"; without a unit number it reads "2015 Kenworth T880".
  • The Location column shows for this user too, because the organization has more than one workplace.
  • With one workplace there is no Location column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R6, S13-R7, S13-R9); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R6: “The column set will be one across every group, with cells adapting rather than columns changing: asset, customer, service, due status, due with its confidence or rule beneath, work order with its status, actions”
  • S13-R7: “The unit will read as unit number followed by year, make and model, falling back to year, make and model where there is no unit number”
  • S13-R9: “This holds for every user of that organization, including one who can open only one of its workplaces”
  • S13-R9: “The location column will render only for an organization with more than one workplace”
